<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the molecule appears to contain a singlet methyl (3 H) attached to an aromatic ring, two equivalent –CH₂–CH₂– groups (each 2 H, triplets, J≈7 Hz) linking a carbonyl to a second aromatic ring, and a total of nine aromatic protons (7 H at 7.17 ppm and 2 H at 7.90 ppm). This fits a structure of a phenyl‑ketone with an ethyl bridge to a p‑methyl‑phenyl group: O=C(Ph)‑CH₂‑CH₂‑Ph‑CH₃. The corresponding SMILES is:

**O=C(c1ccccc1)CCc2ccc(cc2)C**

<thought>All data are consistent with this SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)CCc2ccc(cc2)C</final_answer>
